newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to continue rallying on Sunday with buying expected from small and institutional investors, brokers said.
"The investors may come forward with fresh commitments as there is (talk) that the management of the DSE may be reorganised to bolster the market," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.

Brokers said any change in the council, an administrative body which runs the bourse, would lift confidence, after the market was shaken recently by price manipulations. The DSE benchmark index closed 20.59 points or 2.15 percent up at 978.07 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
